# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C4, the Golden Horde line (oe_glh_). Generated by gen_golden_horde.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 8 "glh") while BYZ has no
# oe_glh_over. World steps first, then the books, then at most one Byzantine event.
oe_glh_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_glh_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_done } OR = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } AND = { country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GLH } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_void value = 3 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_glh_void value = 2 } }
        set_variable = oe_glh_over
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } }
        set_variable = oe_glh_over
    }
    else = {
        oe_glh_world = yes
        oe_glh_books = yes
        oe_glh_events = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. World steps W1-W10 (global variables oe_glh_w<n>: 1 done, 2 window passed without it; W3 see below).
oe_glh_world = {
    # Tini Beg's months on the throne (W3 waits for 4)
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_tini_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_tini_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_tini_m value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_glh_tini_m add = 1 }
    }
    # W1
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w1 } var:oe_glh_m >= 34 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 36 oe_glh_w1_ok = yes } oe_glh_w1_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w1 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w1 } var:oe_glh_m >= 36 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w1 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W2
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w2 } var:oe_glh_m >= 58 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 59 oe_glh_w2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_w2_ch kill_character = character:glh_giyas_al_din_mohammed_oz_beg_borjigin set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w2 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w2 } var:oe_glh_m >= 59 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w2 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W3: once Özbeg no longer reigns. 2 = Jani Beg succeeded without a coup; 1 = the coup; 3 = neither by the end.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w3 } country_exists = c:GLH NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_giyas_al_din_mohammed_oz_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w3 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 96 oe_glh_w3_ok = yes } oe_glh_w3_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w3 value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w3 } var:oe_glh_m > 96 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w3 value = 3 } }
    # W4
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w4 } var:oe_glh_m >= 81 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 81 oe_glh_w4_ok = yes } oe_glh_w4_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w4 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w4 } var:oe_glh_m >= 81 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w4 value = 2 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo var:oe_glh_m >= 126 }
        remove_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo
        set_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo_over
    }
    # W5
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w5 } var:oe_glh_m >= 247 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 258 oe_glh_w5_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_w5_ch kill_character = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w5 value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w5 } var:oe_glh_m >= 258 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w5 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W6
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w6 } var:oe_glh_m >= 272 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 282 oe_glh_w6_ok = yes } oe_glh_w6_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w6 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w6 } var:oe_glh_m >= 282 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w6 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W7 (oe_glh_kulikovo: 1 done, 2 skipped)
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_kulikovo } var:oe_glh_m >= 525 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 525 oe_glh_w7_ok = yes } oe_glh_w7_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_kulikovo value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_kulikovo value = 2 } }
    }
    # W8
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w8 } var:oe_glh_m >= 537 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 540 oe_glh_w8_ok = yes } oe_glh_w8_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w8 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w8 } var:oe_glh_m >= 540 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w8 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W9
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w9 } var:oe_glh_m >= 548 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 548 oe_glh_w9_ok = yes } oe_glh_w9_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w9 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w9 } var:oe_glh_m >= 548 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w9 value = 2 } }
    }
    # W10
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w10 } var:oe_glh_m >= 701 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_m <= 720 oe_glh_w10_ok = yes } oe_glh_w10_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w10 value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_w10 } var:oe_glh_m >= 720 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w10 value = 2 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. W1: Alexander of Tver is put to death at Sarai, by order of the khan; Tver holds it against Moscow.
oe_glh_w1_do = {
    c:GLH ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_glh_khan } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_glh_khan } kill_character = { target = character:tve_aleksandr_mikhailovich_rurikovich reason = execution killer = scope:oe_glh_khan } }
    else = { kill_character = { target = character:tve_aleksandr_mikhailovich_rurikovich reason = execution } }
    c:TVE ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes country_exists = c:MOS } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_bw_tver_grief target = c:MOS } } }
}
# BYZ scope. W3: Jani Beg takes the throne and Tini Beg is killed.
oe_glh_w3_do = {
    c:GLH = { set_new_ruler = character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin }
    if = { limit = { character:glh_tini_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes } } kill_character = { target = character:glh_tini_beg_borjigin reason = assassination } }
}
# BYZ scope. W4: the bloodshed at Tana; the Italians are expelled and Venice and Genoa declare an embargo.
oe_glh_w4_do = {
    set_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo
    c:GLH ?= { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GAZ } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_bw_tana target = c:GAZ } } }
    c:GAZ ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_bw_tana target = c:GLH } } }
    c:GEN ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_bw_tana target = c:GLH } } }
}
# Country scope (the Horde). Horde unity down to 30 when it is higher (vanilla's horde civil war can start at 40 or less).
oe_glh_unity_to_30 = {
    if = { limit = { horde_unity > 30 } add_horde_unity = { value = horde_unity multiply = -1 add = 30 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W6: Berdi Beg dies; the line of Batu ends and the Horde falls apart.
oe_glh_w6_do = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_berdi_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } kill_character = character:glh_berdi_beg_borjigin }
    c:GLH ?= { oe_glh_unity_to_30 = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. W7: Kulikovo. Moscow wins glory at a heavy cost in men; the Horde loses unity and prestige. No war.
oe_glh_w7_do = {
    c:MOS ?= {
        add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_glh_kulikovo_glory years = 10 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { monthly_manpower > 0 } add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -24 } }
    }
    c:GLH ?= {
        add_horde_unity = horde_unity_mild_penalty
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W8: Tokhtamysh unites the Horde: the pretenders are gone, unity and stability rise so that vanilla's end
# condition of the horde civil war holds next month (vanilla then runs its on_end and horde_civil_war.100).
oe_glh_w8_do = {
    c:GLH ?= {
        every_rebel = { limit = { rebel_category = pretender } prev = { destroy_rebel = prev } }
        add_horde_unity = horde_unity_radical_bonus
        if = { limit = { stability < 30 } add_stability = { value = stability multiply = -1 add = 30 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W9: Tokhtamysh burns Moscow; the glory of the Don is gone.
oe_glh_w9_do = {
    location:moscow = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } }
    c:MOS ?= {
        add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_kulikovo_glory } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_kulikovo_glory }
    }
    set_global_variable = oe_glh_moscow_burned
}
# BYZ scope. W10: Timur's armies sack Tana, Sarai and Astrakhan (where the owner is AI).
oe_glh_w10_do = {
    location:tana = { if = { limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } } location:sarai_al_jadid = { if = { limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } } location:astrakhan = { if = { limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes } } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 5 mode = replace } } }
    set_global_variable = oe_glh_tana_ruined
}

# BYZ scope. The books: the bet of oe_glh.2, the Great Troubles, Timur and the Horde.
oe_glh_books = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { var:oe_glh_bet ?= 1 var:oe_glh_bet ?= 2 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_bet_res }
            OR = {
                has_global_variable = oe_glh_w3
                AND = { var:oe_glh_m >= 69 NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_giyas_al_din_mohammed_oz_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } }
            }
        }
        oe_glh_bet_settle = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_troubles } var:oe_glh_m >= 217 country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:horde_civil_war } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_troubles value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_troubles global_var:oe_glh_troubles = 1 NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:horde_civil_war } } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_troubles value = 2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_timur_ally } var:oe_glh_m >= 469 country_exists = c:TIM c:TIM = { is_allied_with = { target = c:GLH } } }
        set_global_variable = oe_glh_timur_ally
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_timur_war } var:oe_glh_m >= 577 country_exists = c:TIM c:TIM = { is_at_war_with = c:GLH } }
        set_global_variable = oe_glh_timur_war
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Settles the bet: the khan now reigning against the one the empire courted (1 Tini Beg, 2 Jani Beg).
oe_glh_bet_settle = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:GLH } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_glh_bet_res value = 0 }
    }
    else = {
        c:GLH = { remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_b_sarai_gifts target = c:BYZ } }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { AND = { var:oe_glh_bet = 1 country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_tini_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } AND = { var:oe_glh_bet = 2 country_exists = c:GLH character:glh_jani_beg_borjigin ?= { is_alive = yes is_ruler_of = c:GLH } } } }
            c:GLH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_b_bet_won target = c:BYZ } }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_glh_sarai_friend years = 20 mode = replace }
            set_variable = { name = oe_glh_bet_res value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            c:GLH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_glh_b_bet_lost target = c:BYZ } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_glh_bet_res value = -1 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Byzantine events: windows that passed are given up; .7 ends the main part, .8 the line.
oe_glh_events = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_1 } var:oe_glh_m > 48 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_2 } var:oe_glh_m > 53 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_3 } var:oe_glh_m > 120 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_4 } var:oe_glh_m > 288 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_5 } var:oe_glh_m > 576 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_6 } var:oe_glh_m > 536 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_7 } var:oe_glh_m > 600 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_8 } var:oe_glh_m > 768 } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_7 NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_done } } set_variable = oe_glh_done }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_8 } set_variable = oe_glh_over }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_over } oe_ml_free = yes oe_glh_byz_calm = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 7 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 0 oe_glh_open_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_glh_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_glh_pick value = 8 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 1 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 2 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 3 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 4 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 5 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 5 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 6 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 6 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 7 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 7 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_glh_pick = 8 } oe_glh_fire = { n = 8 } }
        remove_variable = oe_glh_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends event oe_glh.$n$ when its own conditions hold (scheduler and test buttons; no window, no roll).
oe_glh_fire = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_glh_ok_$n$ = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_glh_fired_$n$ value = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_glh.$n$
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The empire's leaning in Rus' (oe_glh_rus_lean, -3..3: + Moscow, - Tver or Lithuania).
oe_glh_lean = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_glh_rus_lean } } set_variable = { name = oe_glh_rus_lean value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_glh_rus_lean add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_glh_rus_lean min = -3 max = 3 }
}

# Test helpers (dev page and console, BYZ scope).
# Clears this line's BYZ variables and modifiers; the world (deaths, globals, other countries' opinions) stays.
oe_glh_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_m } remove_variable = oe_glh_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_st } remove_variable = oe_glh_st }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_pick } remove_variable = oe_glh_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_bet } remove_variable = oe_glh_bet }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_bet_res } remove_variable = oe_glh_bet_res }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_tini_m } remove_variable = oe_glh_tini_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_rus_lean } remove_variable = oe_glh_rus_lean }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_embargo_side } remove_variable = oe_glh_embargo_side }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_church_channel } remove_variable = oe_glh_church_channel }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_kul_stance } remove_variable = oe_glh_kul_stance }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_khan_recognized } remove_variable = oe_glh_khan_recognized }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_done } remove_variable = oe_glh_done }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_over } remove_variable = oe_glh_over }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_void } remove_variable = oe_glh_void }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_1 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_2 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_3 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_4 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_5 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_6 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_6 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_7 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_7 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_glh_fired_8 } remove_variable = oe_glh_fired_8 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_sarai_friend } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_sarai_friend }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_grain_dear } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_grain_dear }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_north_grain } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_north_grain }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_north_trade } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_north_trade }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_glh_east_route } remove_country_modifier = oe_glh_east_route }
    location:luleburgaz = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_glh_arkadiopolis } remove_location_modifier = oe_glh_arkadiopolis } }
    capital ?= { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_glh_arkadiopolis } remove_location_modifier = oe_glh_arkadiopolis } }
}
# Horde unity down to 30 (vanilla's horde civil war then starts within months).
oe_glh_test_unity30 = { c:GLH ?= { oe_glh_unity_to_30 = yes } }
# W7 Kulikovo now, without the AI and date checks.
oe_glh_w7_force = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MOS country_exists = c:GLH }
        oe_glh_w7_do = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_kulikovo value = 1 }
    }
}
# W8 now (end the horde civil war), and mark the Great Troubles over so oe_glh.7 can be fired.
oe_glh_w8_force = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GLH }
        oe_glh_w8_do = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_w8 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_glh_troubles value = 2 }
    }
}
